title: From Seattle: Private Seattle City Tour
includes: Professional tour guide and local expert
Door-to-door service available from Seattle, Bellevue, Renton, SeaTac, or Tukwila hotels
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Please contact local service provider to arrange pickup from your hotel or a nearby location after you have received your confirmation.
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
Traffic and road conditions may alter tour route
Please allow up to 3 hours for hotel pickup and drop-off service
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore Seattle at your own pace on this private & professionally-guided City Tour. The tour begins from your hotel, where your personal local expert will pick your party up in a Pearl Chevrolet Suburban LTZ. From there, sit back and relax while your guide follows a 50-mile, 7 neighborhood route of the best sites in Seattle. Comfortably take in sites from T-Mobile Park to the Fremont Troll on this 3-hour tour. Scheduled stops include Pioneer Square, the Ballard Locks and Kerry Park, unless otherwise requested. Tour includes history and short photo opportunities at Pike Place Market and the Space Needle. Special requests granted when possible. Luggage not included in rate.
